sections.title: Vowel Changes in the Stem
sections.content:
In some verbs the vowel of the stem changes in every form except *nosotros* and *vosotros*. Three reflexive routine verbs do this:
- **despertarse** (e → ie): *me despierto*
- **acostarse** (o → ue): *me acuesto*
- **sentarse** (e → ie): *me siento*

items.spanish: Me despierto a las seis, pero me levanto a las ocho.
items.english: I wake up at six, but I get up at eight.

items.spanish: ¿A qué hora te acuestas los fines de semana?
items.english: What time do you go to bed on weekends?

items.spanish: Carlos se acuesta muy tarde porque trabaja mucho.
items.english: Carlos goes to bed very late because he works a lot.

items.spanish: Nosotros nos sentamos en la sala.
items.english: We sit down in the living room.

sections.content: Remember the distinction: *despertarse* means opening your eyes / waking up, while *levantarse* means physically leaving the bed!
